entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Kondoa
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The diocese of Kondoa is a see of the Roman Catholic Church suffragan of the Archdiocese of Dodoma. In 2011 it counted 46,067 baptized among 541,345 inhabitants. Its current bishop is Bernardin Mfumbusa.
